question.text: The reaction of nitroprusside anion with sulphide ion gives purple colouration due to the formation of

options.text: the tetranionic complex of iron (II) coordinating to one $NOS^{-}$ ion
the dianoinic complex of iron (II) coordinating to one $NCS^{-}$ ion
the trianoionic complex of iron (III) coordinating to one $NOS^{-}$ ion
the tetranionic complex of iron (III) coordinating to one $NCS^{-}$ ion
